description: This file defines a plugin system for the 'wic' build tool, including base classes for 'imager' and 'source' plugins, mechanisms for plugin registration, and methods related to partition and disk image handling.

classes.name: PluginMgr
classes.description: Manages plugin discovery and loading from specified directories based on plugin type.

classes.name: PluginMeta
classes.description: A metaclass for plugin classes, responsible for registration into the PLUGINS dict.

classes.name: ImagerPlugin
classes.description: Base class for image creation plugins, requiring implementation of the 'do_create' method.

classes.name: SourcePlugin
classes.description: Base class for 'source' type plugins, providing hooks for disk and partition operations.

methods.name: get_plugins(cls, ptype)
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of plugin name to class mappings for a given plugin type.

methods.name: do_create(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to create a plugin; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: do_install_disk(cls, disk, disk_name, creator, workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Hook for finalizing disk images after partition assembly.

methods.name: do_stage_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Prepares content for a partition before configuration.

methods.name: do_configure_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Creates or updates configuration files for a partition.

methods.name: do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Populates a partition with content during image building.

methods.name: do_post_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Performs actions after partition creation, such as signing.

ctags.pattern: /^    def do_configure_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir,$/
ctags.signature: (cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
